title: P1 Architect: add a supported sensor-input binding operation
body: DEVAI 2.2.0 reads sensor-inputs.json but its registered init actions cannot materialize it, and adopter-policy rejects that field. Source: law/policy/scorecard-sensor-inputs.json. Add upstream support in a separately authorized task; do not hand-write protected configuration or patch installed dependencies. Acceptance: registered init action validates and materializes the adopter source with a digest, retaining thresholds and surfaces. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.
resolution: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-e9e45a4a/assessment.md — Registered init bind materializes the schema-valid policy declaration under published DEVAI 2.6.3.
